advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Guard test_sweep_extra_parity_would_have_caught_c57057f41 against an unreachable historical commit (shallow clone) with a pytest.skip carrying an actionable message rather than a hard CalledProcessError.
evidence: ABSENCE: no guard/skip for the case where the abbreviated SHA c57057f41 is not present in the local object store (shallow clone), so the test errors rather than skipping with an actionable message
advisory.finding: test_sweep_extra_parity_would_have_caught_c57057f41 depends on `git show c57057f41:...` succeeding under check=True; in a shallow CI checkout (common for GitHub Actions with limited fetch-depth) that historical commit may be unreachable, raising CalledProcessError and turning an environmental limitation into a hard test error unrelated to the invariant.
advisory.suggested_fix: Run `git cat-file -e c57057f41^{commit}` (or check the returncode without check=True) and `pytest.skip('c57057f41 unavailable in this checkout; deepen fetch to run the anti-vacuity regression')` when the object is absent.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a negative test that injects a sweep-only extra (e.g. add `--extra example` to the sweep install run with gating unchanged) and asserts the 'sweep-only extra(s) absent from the Verified gating lane' branch fires.
evidence: tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py:213-216 add the branch: `if sweep_only:` ... append("sweep-only extra(s) absent from the Verified gating lane: " + ...)

The only negative case, test_sweep_install_extra_drift_is_declared_and_actionable, injects `--extra example` into the GATING (BAT) run and asserts 'gating-only' in message (lines 248-260) — it exercises only unexpected_gating_only.

ABSENCE: no test constructs a test.yml whose sweep install adds an extra missing from the BAT gating install (e.g. gating={dev,reviewbot,ui,grounding-terraform}, sweep install run gains `--extra example`), so the assertion `'sweep-only extra(s) absent from the Verified gating lane: example'` is never verified to fire.
tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py:217-220 add the branch: `if stale_declarations:` ... append("stale intentional gating-only declaration(s): " + ...)
stale_declarations = sorted(allowed - (gating - sweep)) (line 205) — fires when a declared divergence is not actually a gating-only extra.

ABSENCE: no test passes `intentional_gating_only={'grounding-terraform': ...}` against workflow text where grounding-terraform appears in BOTH gating and sweep (so gating-sweep no longer contains it), which is the concrete input that would make the 'stale intentional gating-only declaration(s): grounding-terraform' message fire.
advisory.finding: The newly added `sweep_only` failure branch of `_assert_sweep_extra_parity` (an extra installed by the sweep lane but absent from the Verified gating lane) is never exercised by any negative-case test, so a regression that stops raising it would go undetected.
merged_from: The newly added `stale_declarations` failure branch of `_assert_sweep_extra_parity` (an intentional gating-only divergence that no longer applies because the extra is now in both lanes) is never exercised by any negative-case test.
scenarios: A future refactor of `_assert_sweep_extra_parity` drops or inverts the sweep_only computation; no test turns red.

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Assert the negative-test replace actually mutated the fixture (e.g. `assert divergent_bat != bat_text`) so a future reformat of the install line surfaces as a clear failure rather than relying only on the downstream message check.
evidence: tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py:248-251: `divergent_bat = _read(_BAT_YML).replace("--extra dev --extra reviewbot --extra ui", "--extra dev --extra reviewbot --extra ui --extra example")`
.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:495: `uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra reviewbot --extra ui --extra grounding-terraform ...` (the substring currently exists, but the coupling is brittle)
Mitigation: the subsequent `assert "example" in message` catches a no-op replace, so it fails loudly rather than falsely passing
dropped.finding: The negative-path fixture in test_sweep_install_extra_drift_is_declared_and_actionable is coupled by an exact literal substring `--extra dev --extra reviewbot --extra ui` to the _build-and-test.yml install line; if that install spelling is reformatted (e.g. line-wrapped or reordered), str.replace becomes a silent no-op producing an unmutated fixture, weakening the negative assertion's intent.
